subject.title: feat(workboard): clarify proof provenance and diagnostics

question: Should Workboard expose `independently_verified` as a caller-declared persisted proof label even though the plugin cannot independently attest to the evidence?
rationale: This determines the durable meaning of a new contract value across tools, SQLite data, UI, and documentation; code review cannot decide the desired product assurance level.

options.title: Approve caller-declared provenance
options.body: Keep the enum and documentation as proposed while explicitly stating that Workboard does not attest to verification.

options.title: Use a less assertive value
options.body: Rename or constrain the value so downstream consumers cannot read it as assurance issued by Workboard.

recommendation.title: Approve caller-declared provenance
recommendation.body: Keep the enum and documentation as proposed while explicitly stating that Workboard does not attest to verification.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied context connects this contributor to both current and related Workboard proof-contract work; final product approval remains an owner decision.
